        try:
            proc = self.sandbox.exec(
                "sh",
                "-lc",

replacements.after:
def write_file(self, file_path: str, content: str):
        payload = base64.b64encode(content.encode()).decode()
        script = (
            "import base64, pathlib, sys\n"
            "path = pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1])\n"
            "if path.parent and str(path.parent) not in ('', '.') and not path.parent.exists():\n"
            "    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n"
            "path.write_bytes(base64.b64decode(sys.argv[2]))\n"
        )
        p = self.sandbox.exec("python", "-c", script, file_path, payload)
        stdout = []
        stderr = []
        try:
            asyncio.run(self._read_output(p, stdout, stderr))
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"Error during file write: {e}")
        p.wait()
        if p.returncode != 0:
            output = "".join(stdout + stderr)
            raise RuntimeError(
                f"Failed to write sandbox file {file_path!r}: {output}"
            )

        # FilesystemExecutionError. Create the log directories inside the
        # sandbox instead; this uses the exec path that agents/verifiers use.
        await self.exec(
            "mkdir -p "
            f"{EnvironmentPaths.agent_dir} {EnvironmentPaths.verifier_dir} && "
            f"chmod 777 {EnvironmentPaths.agent_dir} {EnvironmentPaths.verifier_dir}"
